g.text: Spring assistance: force, preload and drum size

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526374

g.text: Level static support • 25–75° hip travel • 90% of a linear gravity-torque fit • All spring forces are per leg

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526374

g.text: A, C, D compare separately retuned spring designs. B varies preload only, holding stiffness at 7.349 N/mm and drum radius at 50 mm.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526374

g.text: B minimizes angle-averaged torque squared; the motor may need to oppose the spring. It does not optimize battery range or an obstacle trajectory.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526374

g.text: Knee torque assumes relative knee = −2 × hip angle. No uneven loading, airborne wheel, dynamics, friction or spring hysteresis. • 2026-10-03
